source:
@@U04216@@
and if they take the pass, were in real danger.

@@U04218@@
So I've been deceived after all. You've lured me into your net. I’ve been uneasy about it from the start.

@@U04220@@
Don't lose heart, it isn’t over yet. Patience and a little cunning will do the trick. It’s always nastiest toward the end. Besides, I have messengers I can count on. What say, Sire, you let me take over the command?

@@U04222@@
(Approaching the EMPEROR.)

@@U04223@@
You allied yourself with these two, Majesty, an alliance that has pained me from the start, for trickery won’ sustain you in the end. There’s nothing I can do at this point. Let them finish it as they've begun. I return to you my commander's baton.

@@U04225@@
Keep it for better times that fortune perhaps may lend us. This repulsive creature and his raven friends make me shudder.

@@U04226@@
(To 梅菲斯特.)

@@U04227@@
No, I can’t give you the baton. You're not the right man for it. But issue what orders you need to and free us! Do whatever it takes.

@@U04228@@
(He and the COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF retire to the tent.)
translation:
@@U04216@@
如果他们攻克了这个关口，那就真的处于危险之中了。

@@U04218@@
所以说到底我还是被骗了。你已经把我引诱到你的网里了。我从一开始就对此感到不安。

@@U04220@@
别灰心，事情还没有结束。耐心和一点狡猾就会成功。到最后总是最糟糕的。此外，我还有可以信赖的使者。怎么说呢，陛下，您让我接手指挥权吧？

@@U04222@@
（走近皇帝。）

@@U04223@@
陛下，您与这两个人结盟，这个联盟从一开始就让我痛苦，因为诡计最终无法支撑您。此时我无能为力。让他们像开始一样完成它。我把我的指挥官的指挥棒还给你。

@@U04225@@
保留它，以便命运可能借给我们更好的时光。这个令人厌恶的生物和他的乌鸦朋友让我不寒而栗。

@@U04226@@
（对梅菲斯特。）

@@U04227@@
不，我不能把接力棒交给你。你不是合适的人选。但请发出你需要的命令并释放我们！尽一切努力。

@@U04228@@
（他和总司令退到帐篷里。）
